title: Deterministic VCR proxy + synthetic streaming fixtures for SDK contract tests
creator: Alex Moran
description: Build a deterministic VCR-style proxy and a library of synthetic streaming fixtures to make cross-language SDK contract tests reproducible and resilient. The proxy should support recording live Redwood API sessions and replaying them deterministically for Python/TS/Go SDK test suites, while the synthetic stream fixtures should allow us to craft hard-to-capture real-world behaviours (chunked transfer patterns, mid-stream disconnects, slow producers, reordered chunks, long-latency first byte) that currently cause flakey CI. Goals: (1) reduce flaky streaming tests by 80% across SDK CI, (2) enable CI contract runs that do not need live API credentials, and (3) provide maintainable, auditable fixture artifacts with explicit redaction rules for sensitive fields.
acceptance_criteria: Proxy can record a live session against Redwood hosted API and emit a redacted deterministic fixture file (seeded randomness + timestamp normalization)
Repeatable replay mode that returns identical byte/chunk boundaries for streaming responses across Python/TS/Go SDKs
Synthetic fixture generator exposes knobs for: chunk size distribution, inter-chunk delay distribution, connection drop at offset, partial JSON chunk scenarios, and chunk reordering
CI integration examples for python-sdk (pytest), ts-sdk (jest), go-sdk (gotest) that run against replay mode without network access
Documentation and migration guide for existing flaky streaming tests with two example migrations
Cross-language contract test that asserts token-level stream reassembly and retry behavior for at-least-once and idempotent endpoints
comments: 2026-02-20 Alex Moran: Initial proposal and spike plan. Will prototype a lightweight node-based proxy that can act as both recorder and deterministic replayer. Consider existing WireMock-like projects but need low-level access to streaming byte boundaries.

2026-02-24 Priya Shah: Spike prototype done. Node proxy + wasm-based deterministic RNG produced repeatable results for simple streams. Captured first Redwood streaming session and replayed with identical chunk boundaries.

2026-02-28 Diego Alvarez (code review): Suggest adding explicit redaction rules: api_key, user_id, email, and long-lived session ids. Also recommend store mapping table for tokenized values to allow safe comparisons in assertions.

2026-03-01 QA note (Marta Liu): Ran prototype across python-sdk CI runner. Found flakiness reduced but replays occasionally differ when KV cache headers present. Added to acceptance criteria: normalize runtime headers and cache-timestamps.

2026-03-03 Priya Shah: Implemented synthetic fixture DSL and examples: slow_start.json (high initial latency), drop_mid_stream.json (disconnect at 2.4s), chunk_splinter.json (many tiny chunks), partial_json_boundary.json (JSON token split across chunks). Added tests in ts-sdk/example-replay and python-sdk/stream-fixtures.

2026-03-05 PM review (Ravi Kumar): Approved approach. Request to add a short living migration doc explaining how to record with redaction and how to re-generate fixtures if API contract changes. Marking P1 due to impact on SDK release cadence.
